phase_transition.boundary: qualification execution and record publication only; preservation authority, adoption, GATING activation, and any deployed change remain unauthorized and human-decided

execution.sanctioned: first and only sanctioned execution of the frozen m4rel candidate against the frozen qualification material
execution.reexecution_policy: three logged evaluator-only re-executions on pinned detector bytes; fixture-level identity mechanically verified for preserved execution 1 vs final run, NOT independently for unretained runs 2–3
execution.order: pins verified before any detection; fresh holdout manifest integrity verified before its single execution

evaluator_correction.defect: G5 aggregation inverted the control-correctness predicate (c_ok == 0 instead of c_ok == len(controls)); fixture-level results were complete and correct in the first report
evaluator_correction.fixture_comparison_scope: preserved execution 1 vs final run only; intermediate run-2/run-3 reports are not retained and their fixture identity is not independently verifiable
evaluator_correction.provenance_limit: execution-log.jsonl entries 1 and 2 are retrospectively reconstructed; run-2/run-3 report hashes are recorded but report bytes are unavailable. Neither the log nor the pinned module alone proves their fixture-level outputs.
